import json, pathlib, shutil
root = pathlib.Path('data/orders')
backup = pathlib.Path('/tmp/order-backup-1794794709626')

count = 0
for path in root.rglob('*.json'):
    text = path.read_text()
    order = json.loads(text)
    if order['status'] == 'paid':
        assert 'itemCount' not in order
        qty = sum(item['qty'] for item in order['items'])
        end = text.rfind('}')
        assert end >= 0 and not text[end+1:].strip()
        prefix = text[:end].rstrip()
        path.write_text(prefix + ',\n  "itemCount": ' + str(qty) + '\n}' + text[end+1:])
        count += 1
print('Updated', count, 'paid orders')

python3 - <<'PY'
import json, pathlib
root = pathlib.Path('data/orders')
backup = pathlib.Path('/tmp/order-backup-1794794709626')
paid = other = 0
for path in root.rglob('*.json'):
    old_text = (backup / path.relative_to(root)).read_text()
    new_text = path.read_text()
    old, new = json.loads(old_text), json.loads(new_text)
    if old['status'] == 'paid':
        expected = sum(item['qty'] for item in old['items'])
        assert new.pop('itemCount') == expected, path
        assert new == old, path
        end = old_text.rfind('}')
        assert new_text == old_text[:end].rstrip() + ',\n  "itemCount": ' + str(expected) + '\n}' + old_text[end+1:], path
        paid += 1
    else:
        assert new_text == old_text, path
        other += 1
print(f'Verified {paid} paid orders and {other} unchanged non-paid orders')
